# Pull Request Information - **PR #**: 1295 - **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1295 - **Title**: gh-1292 fa-tokens line must reach stdout in headless/CI runs (ledger emission invisible to the GH log) - **Author**: ai-teammate - **Branch**: `ai/gh-1292` → `main` - **State**: open - **Files Changed**: 3 - **Additions**: +228 - **Deletions**: -31 - **Created**: 2026-10-05T15:36:47Z - **Updated**: 2026-10-05T22:45:38Z ## PR Description Closes #1292 ### What changed `runHeadless` now asks the usage-ledger segment-close flush to mirror the `fa-tokens:` line to stdout (via `CliIO.write`, the stdout channel — headless hosts route `writeln` to stderr). The diag-file write to `~/.fah/logs/fa.log` is unchanged, so CI log capture finally sees the line the dmtools-agents token reporter greps for. ### Key decisions - **Gating is explicit, not `!_useTui`**: `_flushUsageLedger({bool mirrorTokensLineToStdout = false})` — only the headless leg passes `true`. The first `!_useTui`-only version broke a PTY e2e test (`yolo_rm_critical_e2e_test.dart`); interactive REPL exit/switch flushes keep stdout clean. - **Structured modes need no extra guard**: HEP `--output events` and `--output-format stream-json` hosts wrap io in `HepEventsIO`, which drops `write` — their frames own stdout, so the JSONL wires stay pure by construction. - **TUI guard retained** (`mirror && !_useTui`) so TUI-attached sessions keep stdout clean even if a headless-shaped run ever coexists with TUI. - Stdout line has no timestamp prefix (unlike fa.log), so it matches the reporter's pinned `usageTokensLogPattern` as-is. ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/cli/agent_cli_usage_ledger_test.dart ``` Covers: headless run → stdout line matches `usageTokensLogPattern`; TUI-attached session → stdout clean; stream-json (`HepEventsIO`-wrapped) → NDJSON wire clean; interactive REPL `/exit` → stdout clean; diag-log write unchanged in all cases. Note: `test/integration/{yolo_rm_critical_e2e,backend_mode_cli,headless_log_file}_test.dart` (and browser_ext e2e) fail in this environment **without** this change too — verified at clean base `19a9f2b` (assistant text never reaches the mock subprocess, `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env notes; the suite also dies on a native malloc crash). Pre-existing, unrelated.
Flow ```mermaid flowchart TD HEAD[runHeadless finally] --> FLUSH[_flushUsageLedger mirror=true] REPL[REPL exit / session switch] --> FLUSH2[_flushUsageLedger default] FLUSH --> DIAG[_logDiagnostic → fa.log] FLUSH -->|!_useTui| OUT[io.write → stdout CI log] FLUSH2 --> DIAG HEP[HepEventsIO wraps io
HEP / stream-json] -. drops write .-> OUT ```

## What actually failed

The `fa-tokens:` mirror (gh-1292 round 1) emitted the segment-close line via `CliIO.write` — the headless **stdout / primary stream**. That broke the 10 unit tests that pin headless stdout as byte-identical assistant prose (issue #774 AC3 / the `CliIO` channel contract):

- `test/cli/headless_cli_test.dart` × 4 — `write` channel must carry the answer only (or stay empty on error/abort paths)
- `test/cli/markdown_surface_test.dart` × 5 — piped stdout must stay byte-identical raw (AC3), TTY render byte-exact

Flag renamed `mirrorTokensLineToStdout` → `mirrorTokensLineToRunLog`; TUI guard and REPL defaults unchanged; `HepEventsIO` forwards the line to the host diagnostics channel so the NDJSON wires stay pure.

`--attach` sniffs image mimes by magic bytes (png/jpeg/gif/webp ride
  as base64 blocks); any other file passes through as an
  `[attached file: …]` path reference appended to the prompt (issue
  #196) — never an octet-stream image block.
- `bin/fah.dart` — the `fah`/`fa` CLI. REPL (no args) or headless
  (`fa "prompt"` / `-p` / `--prompt-file <path>` (alias `-f`), mutually
  exclusive). First positional naming an EXISTING file is the prompt source
  (`.md`/`.txt` inlined, others attached by reference; `-p` is verbatim;
  `--prompt-file` reads ANY path verbatim, missing/unreadable = usage
  error exit 64). Args parsed in `lib/src/cli/cli_args.dart`
  (pure Dart). Headless: exit 0/1/130; `CliIO` contract — `write` = primary
  stream, `writeln` = diagnostics (stderr headless). The TUI captures the
  mouse by default (wheel scrolling + click routing — the alternate screen
  has no native scrollback): SGR 1002+1006 with a per-frame hit-region
  registry (`tui_hit_regions.dart`, topmost-region click/drag/release
  routing in `fa_tui_mouse.dart` — composer caret on mousedown, model
  picker rows, queue-row drop); legacy X10 payloads (modes 9/1000) decode
  too; `/mouse off` degrades to keyboard with a one-time hint. Selection
  works via the terminal's bypass modifier (Shift), and `FA_TUI_MOUSE=0`
  (`AgentCliConfig.tuiMouseCapture`) hands the mouse back for always-on
  native select-to-copy.
  Shift+Enter's HID poll is resolved once at startup
  (`lib/src/cli/shift_hid.dart`, issue #355): disabled when
  `SSH_CONNECTION`/`SSH_TTY` is set, under `FA_TUI_SHIFT_HID=0`, or when
  the one-shot CoreGraphics probe (sacrificial isolate, ~300 ms timeout)
  hangs — the returned callback is null and a bare CR stays a submit.
- `lib/src/cli/` — REPL machinery: `/provider [name] [baseUrl] [token] |
  custom` (guided wizard in `provider_flow.dart` + `provider_commands.dart`;
  `/models` fetched for openai-like endpoints), custom providers in the
  `customProviders:` section of `~/.fah/config.yaml`. Editing a saved
  OAuth-connected entry (OpenRouter) offers the connect-time sign-in choice

# Pull Request Information - **PR #**: 1295 - **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1295 - **Title**: gh-1292 fa-tokens line must reach stdout in headless/CI runs (ledger emission invisible to the GH log) - **Author**: ai-teammate - **Branch**: `ai/gh-1292` → `main` - **State**: open - **Files Changed**: 3 - **Additions**: +228 - **Deletions**: -31 - **Created**: 2026-10-05T15:36:47Z - **Updated**: 2026-10-05T22:45:38Z ## PR Description Closes #1292 ### What changed `runHeadless` now asks the usage-ledger segment-close flush to mirror the `fa-tokens:` line to stdout (via `CliIO.write`, the stdout channel — headless hosts route `writeln` to stderr). The diag-file write to `~/.fah/logs/fa.log` is unchanged, so CI log capture finally sees the line the dmtools-agents token reporter greps for. ### Key decisions - **Gating is explicit, not `!_useTui`**: `_flushUsageLedger({bool mirrorTokensLineToStdout = false})` — only the headless leg passes `true`. The first `!_useTui`-only version broke a PTY e2e test (`yolo_rm_critical_e2e_test.dart`); interactive REPL exit/switch flushes keep stdout clean. - **Structured modes need no extra guard**: HEP `--output events` and `--output-format stream-json` hosts wrap io in `HepEventsIO`, which drops `write` — their frames own stdout, so the JSONL wires stay pure by construction. - **TUI guard retained** (`mirror && !_useTui`) so TUI-attached sessions keep stdout clean even if a headless-shaped run ever coexists with TUI. - Stdout line has no timestamp prefix (unlike fa.log), so it matches the reporter's pinned `usageTokensLogPattern` as-is. ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/cli/agent_cli_usage_ledger_test.dart ``` Covers: headless run → stdout line matches `usageTokensLogPattern`; TUI-attached session → stdout clean; stream-json (`HepEventsIO`-wrapped) → NDJSON wire clean; interactive REPL `/exit` → stdout clean; diag-log write unchanged in all cases. Note: `test/integration/{yolo_rm_critical_e2e,backend_mode_cli,headless_log_file}_test.dart` (and browser_ext e2e) fail in this environment **without** this change too — verified at clean base `19a9f2b` (assistant text never reaches the mock subprocess, `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env notes; the suite also dies on a native malloc crash). Pre-existing, unrelated.
Flow ```mermaid flowchart TD HEAD[runHeadless finally] --> FLUSH[_flushUsageLedger mirror=true] REPL[REPL exit / session switch] --> FLUSH2[_flushUsageLedger default] FLUSH --> DIAG[_logDiagnostic → fa.log] FLUSH -->|!_useTui| OUT[io.write → stdout CI log] FLUSH2 --> DIAG HEP[HepEventsIO wraps io
HEP / stream-json] -. drops write .-> OUT ```

# Re: ⚠️ Validation CI went red on the head — merge aborted, rework re-queued

Red head `1cee1baa` root-caused and fixed — single cause, no separate problem behind any of the four red checks.

## What actually failed

The `fa-tokens:` mirror (gh-1292 round 1) emitted the segment-close line via `CliIO.write` — the headless **stdout / primary stream**. That broke the 10 unit tests that pin headless stdout as byte-identical assistant prose (issue #774 AC3 / the `CliIO` channel contract):

- `test/cli/headless_cli_test.dart` × 4 — `write` channel must carry the answer only (or stay empty on error/abort paths)
- `test/cli/markdown_surface_test.dart` × 5 — piped stdout must stay byte-identical raw (AC3), TTY render byte-exact
- `test/cli/headless_hep_test.dart` × 1 — without a HepWriter stdout stays prose

Core shards 0/3 + hostile-env red on exactly these; `Quality gate` aggregated red. `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)` and `Binaries smoke gate` were skipped by the dispatched (non-`pull_request`) validation run and stamped red downstream — no independent failure.

## The fix

The mirror now rides the **diagnostics channel** (`io.writeln`), which headless hosts route to **stderr** (`bin/fah_io.dart`; AGENTS.md: "`writeln` = diagnostics (stderr headless)"). gh-1292 still holds: the token reporter downloads the **whole GH job log** (`github_get_workflow_run_logs` / `github_get_job_logs`) and scans every line for `fa-tokens:` — stderr is part of that log — while headless stdout stays pipeable prose. Flag renamed `mirrorTokensLineToStdout` → `mirrorTokensLineToRunLog`; TUI guard and REPL defaults unchanged; `HepEventsIO` forwards the line to the host diagnostics channel so the NDJSON wires stay pure.

## Verification

- All 10 failures reproduced locally (RED), then green after the fix.
- Full CI unit scope: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` → 9104 passed / 0 failed (test-core shards + hostile-env scope); the four affected suites also pass under the hostile-env var block; `usage-fold` leg scope green; `dart format` / `dart analyze` clean.

`--attach` sniffs image mimes by magic bytes (png/jpeg/gif/webp ride
  as base64 blocks); any other file passes through as an
  `[attached file: …]` path reference appended to the prompt (issue
  #196) — never an octet-stream image block.
- `bin/fah.dart` — the `fah`/`fa` CLI. REPL (no args) or headless
  (`fa "prompt"` / `-p` / `--prompt-file <path>` (alias `-f`), mutually
  exclusive). First positional naming an EXISTING file is the prompt source
  (`.md`/`.txt` inlined, others attached by reference; `-p` is verbatim;
  `--prompt-file` reads ANY path verbatim, missing/unreadable = usage
  error exit 64). Args parsed in `lib/src/cli/cli_args.dart`
  (pure Dart). Headless: exit 0/1/130; `CliIO` contract — `write` = primary
  stream, `writeln` = diagnostics (stderr headless). The TUI captures the
  mouse by default (wheel scrolling + click routing — the alternate screen
  has no native scrollback): SGR 1002+1006 with a per-frame hit-region
  registry (`tui_hit_regions.dart`, topmost-region click/drag/release
  routing in `fa_tui_mouse.dart` — composer caret on mousedown, model
  picker rows, queue-row drop); legacy X10 payloads (modes 9/1000) decode
  too; `/mouse off` degrades to keyboard with a one-time hint. Selection
  works via the terminal's bypass modifier (Shift), and `FA_TUI_MOUSE=0`
  (`AgentCliConfig.tuiMouseCapture`) hands the mouse back for always-on
  native select-to-copy.
  Shift+Enter's HID poll is resolved once at startup
  (`lib/src/cli/shift_hid.dart`, issue #355): disabled when
  `SSH_CONNECTION`/`SSH_TTY` is set, under `FA_TUI_SHIFT_HID=0`, or when
  the one-shot CoreGraphics probe (sacrificial isolate, ~300 ms timeout)
  hangs — the returned callback is null and a bare CR stays a submit.
- `lib/src/cli/` — REPL machinery: `/provider [name] [baseUrl] [token] |
  custom` (guided wizard in `provider_flow.dart` + `provider_commands.dart`;
  `/models` fetched for openai-like endpoints), custom providers in the
  `customProviders:` section of `~/.fah/config.yaml`. Editing a saved
  OAuth-connected entry (OpenRouter) offers the connect-time sign-in choice

`--attach` sniffs image mimes by magic bytes (png/jpeg/gif/webp ride
  as base64 blocks); any other file passes through as an
  `[attached file: …]` path reference appended to the prompt (issue
  #196) — never an octet-stream image block.
- `bin/fah.dart` — the `fah`/`fa` CLI. REPL (no args) or headless
  (`fa "prompt"` / `-p` / `--prompt-file <path>` (alias `-f`), mutually
  exclusive). First positional naming an EXISTING file is the prompt source
  (`.md`/`.txt` inlined, others attached by reference; `-p` is verbatim;
  `--prompt-file` reads ANY path verbatim, missing/unreadable = usage
  error exit 64). Args parsed in `lib/src/cli/cli_args.dart`
  (pure Dart). Headless: exit 0/1/130; `CliIO` contract — `write` = primary
  stream, `writeln` = diagnostics (stderr headless). The TUI captures the
  mouse by default (wheel scrolling + click routing — the alternate screen
  has no native scrollback): SGR 1002+1006 with a per-frame hit-region
  registry (`tui_hit_regions.dart`, topmost-region click/drag/release
  routing in `fa_tui_mouse.dart` — composer caret on mousedown, model
  picker rows, queue-row drop); legacy X10 payloads (modes 9/1000) decode
  too; `/mouse off` degrades to keyboard with a one-time hint. Selection
  works via the terminal's bypass modifier (Shift), and `FA_TUI_MOUSE=0`
  (`AgentCliConfig.tuiMouseCapture`) hands the mouse back for always-on
  native select-to-copy.
  Shift+Enter's HID poll is resolved once at startup
  (`lib/src/cli/shift_hid.dart`, issue #355): disabled when
  `SSH_CONNECTION`/`SSH_TTY` is set, under `FA_TUI_SHIFT_HID=0`, or when
  the one-shot CoreGraphics probe (sacrificial isolate, ~300 ms timeout)
  hangs — the returned callback is null and a bare CR stays a submit.
- `lib/src/cli/` — REPL machinery: `/provider [name] [baseUrl] [token] |
  custom` (guided wizard in `provider_flow.dart` + `provider_commands.dart`;
  `/models` fetched for openai-like endpoints), custom providers in the
  `customProviders:` section of `~/.fah/config.yaml`. Editing a saved
  OAuth-connected entry (OpenRouter) offers the connect-time sign-in choice
